core_values: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Baroque opulence with Modern Minimalism
Content is King: Gallery-style layouts, negative space is luxury
Contrast: Deep dark backgrounds vs. luminous gold/silver accents
anti_patterns: Rounded-pill buttons (Use sharp or slightly rounded corners)
Flat, boring cards (Use texture, borders, or glassmorphism)

grid_system.marketing: Use Bootstrap 'row' but override with custom gaps. Example: .row-aristocratic { --bs-gutter-x: 3rem; --bs-gutter-y: 3rem; }
grid_system.gallery: Use CSS Grid for masonry layouts. .gallery-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; }

buttons.primary: Background: Transparent; Border: 1px solid var(--color-gold); Color: var(--color-gold); Text-Transform: Uppercase; Letter-Spacing: 2px; Padding: 1rem 2.5rem; Transition: all 0.4s ease. Hover: Background: var(--color-gold); Color: #000;
buttons.secondary: Background: var(--color-primary-deep); Color: #fff; Border: none; Hover: Background: var(--color-primary);

cards.collection_card: Background: var(--color-bg-surface); Border: 1px solid var(--color-border); Position: relative; Overflow: hidden; Transition: transform 0.3s ease. Hover: transform: translateY(-5px); Border-color: var(--color-gold);
cards.feature_card: Glassmorphism effect: Background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); Backdrop-filter: blur(10px); Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);

navbar.style: Background: rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.8); Backdrop-filter: blur(12px); Border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
navbar.links: Font-family: 'Manrope'; Text-transform: uppercase; Letter-spacing: 1px; Color: var(--color-text-muted); Hover: Color: var(--color-gold);

css_architecture.file_structure: Keep all custom styles in wwwroot/css/site.css. Do not use inline styles in .cshtml files unless absolutely necessary for dynamic values.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update wwwroot/css/site.css with the CSS Variables and Global Styles defined above.
2. Update _Layout.cshtml to include the Google Fonts link.
3. Refactor the Navbar in _Layout.cshtml to remove standard Bootstrap classes (bg-light, navbar-light) and apply custom 'navbar-aristocratic' classes.
4. Redesign the Home/Index.cshtml Hero section using the 'Hero' image URLs and the 'Playfair Display' typography.
5. Update the Collections/Index.cshtml grid to use the 'Gallery' grid layout.
6. Ensure all buttons use the 'Cinzel' font and the gold border style.
7. Apply the 'noise' texture to the body background to give it a premium feel.
8. DO NOT change the C# logic or the Razor Page models. Only modify the HTML structure and CSS classes.
universal_guidelines: Use generous padding (min 4rem top/bottom for sections).
Ensure text contrast is high (Gold on Black, White on Black).
Use 'text-transform: uppercase' with 'letter-spacing: 2px' for small labels to add elegance.
Images should have a subtle 'filter: brightness(0.8)' by default and 'brightness(1)' on hover.
